{{Quote|We're all like trees in Gardulla's pleasure garden...trapped here, rooted in a place that we don't want to be.|[[Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine">''[[Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine]]''</ref>}}
'''Gardulla's pleasure garden''' was located in [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|the Hutt's]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Description==
The garden was located underground, and was populated by many [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[:Category:Carnivorous plants|predatory plants]] and [[:Category:Carnivorous creatures|animals]] (with its ''soils'' even prone to swallow). These included [[Deneba bush]]es, [[vesuvague tree]]s, [[glurpfish]], [[Swamp slug/Legends|swamp slugs]], [[quickclay]], [[cucul]], [[Worrt/Legends|worrts]], [[Temptor/Legends|temptors]], [[Urchin (flower)|urchins]], [[Syren plant/Legends|syren plants]], and birds from the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]] called [[Eye-snatcher]]s.<ref name="EIA7">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>

Harboring such perverse entertainment delights for herself and her guests meshed well with Gardulla's unquenchable lust to ever witness the pain and suffering of countless alien victims from a thousand worlds—particularly those chosen, unwary creatures constrained by her cruel and twisted will to venture into the garden, upon its completion. Theirs would be a forced visit to a violent arena that, on first blush, would appear disarmingly peaceful—cloaked by nature—but which in reality would prove to be a venture meant solely for the 'pleasure' of its spectators, when nature disrobed itself at the Hutt's own predatory bidding.<ref name="EIA7" />

==History==
The garden was constructed by [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] gardeners, including [[Oo Wen]].<ref name="EIA7" />

By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], other predatory beasts, known for their particular ferocities but held as yet in reserve, were being negotiated by Gardulla to join the garden's other denizens at some point in the future. All of these bestial plants and animals were meant to prey on the life-force of [[Slavery/Legends|captives]] and innocents alike: such as the delicate and beautiful creatures of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] called [[Wistie/Legends|Wisties]] or those of [[Datar/Legends|Datar]], known as [[Ghostling]]s.<ref name="EIA7" />
